Name: ValleyTalk-Valley Girls All scenes and cutscenes are connected to AI dialogue
Author: ccgfbcg
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Description Integrate all the dialogues and cutscenes that the girl in the "Valley Girl" module enters when she is happy into " ValleyTalk " , enabling unlimited dialogues

！！！Because this mod is based on the Netorare Valley (Valley Girls Event Add-on) mod, I can't guarantee that it will run properly on the original Valley Girls mod，You all can give it a try. If you find any bugs, I'll try my best to fix them.！！！

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list]
[*][b]1，download the original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10532]'Valley Girl'.[/url][/b][/*]
[*][b]2，Download the expansion pack [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40559?tab=files]Netorare Valley(Valley Girls Event Add on)[/url] and replace the main game（If you don't like NTR, you can skip this and see if it has any bugs.）[/b][/*]
[*][b]3，Download[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30319?tab=files] ValleyTalk -Infinite AI Dialogue[/url]Latest Version V1.4.1，The latest version is the one shared by the guy in the comments below, it's [url=https://www.mediafire.com/file/35q3zc63kemnq8q/ValleyTalk_1.4.1.zip/file]this one[/url].[/b][/*]
[*][b]4，Put the mod I uploaded in the mods folder[/b][/*]
[/list]
[b]Main features[/b]
First, it changed how AI understands NPCs in different scenarios according to the current situation, making AI conversations more relevant, and Added porn content generation.

[b]Things to note[/b]
I suggest the AI model pick this one deepseek-flash
Choose this server address https://api.deepseek.com/v1
If the words 'Thinking...' appear in the middle of the screen, it means it's successful.
Since this is my first time making a mod, if there are any bugs, please point them out and I'll try my best to fix them.
